title: I Put the Missing-Kefir Photo on the Fridge They Moderated

parts.text: I taped the missing-kefir photo at 8:14 a.m. on the fridge they moderated. The jar had my name and a Tuesday date. I was twenty-eight, analyst, standing in a kitchen that made me look like I owned the wait. The moderator said labels were atmosphere. I photographed the empty ring, the label, and the camera still of a hand that was not mine. Facilities printed the still. The jar came back with an apology sticky. I keep the ring photo. The fridge finally knows a name from atmosphere.

social.video_title: The fridge they moderated ate my labeled kefir — Part 1/1
social.description: Labeled jar, empty ring, a hand that was not mine. Facilities printed the still. Has a moderator ever called a label atmosphere?
